articles.summary: Dutch Maid Logistics, a family-owned refrigerated carrier in Willard, Ohio, hired its first Emerge Career graduate in March 2025. Today 34 of our grads drive for them. Every one came screened to Dutch Maid's hiring rules and keeps a coach for their first year, at no cost to Dutch Maid.
articles.title: Ready to Grind: The Drivers Dutch Maid Counts On
